Angles written ∠ are read from the figure.

1. BH = BK and CH = CK, so BC is the perpendicular bisector of HK; hence BC ⟂ HK. (1)

2. AH ∥ HK, both ⟂ BC, so H, A, K are collinear. (2)

3. We show that A, B, C, K lie on one circle:

∠C = ∠HBC − 90°    [BH ⟂ AC]
   = ∠BHK    [BC ⟂ HK, by (1)]
   = ∠HKB    [BH = BK]
   = ∠AKB    [H, A, K collinear, by (2)]

So A, B, C, K lie on one circle, as required. ∎
